title: Temporary Works Permit
name: Temporary Works Permit
description: Permit and hold-point record for temporary works from design brief through installation, loading/use, monitoring and striking/removal.

sections.title: DESIGN BRIEF, DESIGN AND CHECK
items: The temporary works requirement is recorded on the project temporary works register
A design brief defines the purpose, loads, constraints, interfaces and sequence
The designer has suitable competence and has received the current design brief
The design has been checked to the project / BS 5975 checking procedure and assigned check category
Design assumptions, permissible loads and hold points are clearly stated
The latest approved drawings and calculations are available to the installation team
Interfaces with permanent works, adjacent structures and other temporary works have been coordinated

fields.label: Design Drawing / Calculation References and Revisions

sections.title: INSTALLATION AND PRE-LOAD INSPECTION
items: Temporary works have been installed to the latest approved design and sequence
Materials and proprietary components are correct, compatible and free from significant defects
Foundations, bearings, supports and connections are suitable for the design loads
Bracing, ties, restraints and stability measures are complete
No unapproved site changes or deviations have been made
The completed installation has been inspected by a competent person before loading or use
Any defects or departures have been resolved or formally accepted by the designer / TWC

sections.title: PERMIT TO LOAD / USE
items: All design and inspection hold points required before loading / use have been released
The TWC has confirmed the temporary works are ready for the intended load / use
Permitted loads, sequence and restrictions have been communicated to those using the temporary works
Load signage / physical restrictions are in place where required
Monitoring and inspection requirements during use are defined

fields.label: Permit to Load / Use Authorised By (TWC or delegated competent person)
Permit to Load / Use Date / Time

sections.title: MONITORING, CHANGE CONTROL AND HOLD POINTS
items: Inspection and monitoring frequencies are suitable for the temporary works and loading sequence
Temporary works will be re-inspected after events that could affect stability or capacity
No change to the design, loading, sequence or support conditions will be made without approval
Design changes are issued, checked and communicated using controlled revisions
Defects or unexpected movement will trigger stop-work, unloading / exclusion and TWC review where necessary

sections.title: PERMIT TO STRIKE / DISMANTLE
items: Permanent works or other supports have achieved the condition required before temporary works are removed
The designer / TWC has confirmed the striking or dismantling sequence and any residual support requirements
Loads have been removed or transferred in the approved sequence
The dismantling team has been briefed on stability, exclusion and access controls
Temporary works will not be removed prematurely or in an unapproved sequence

fields.label: Evidence Prerequisites for Striking Are Met
Permit to Strike / Remove Authorised By

sections.title: CLOSE-OUT
items: Temporary works have been removed or formally transferred to another controlled status
Permanent works and surrounding area have been inspected for damage or residual risk
Temporary works register and design records have been updated
Outstanding actions and lessons learned have been recorded
